name: AI NavHub

sources.title: Submit Your AI Tool - AI NavHub

requirements: AI tools only (writing, coding, video, SEO, design, education, etc. - 300+ tools directory)
Form fields: Website Name, Website URL, Email
Free submission per FAQ: 'submission is free. We encourage tool creators to include a backlink to AI NavHub' (encouraged, not required)
preparation: Website name, URL, and a contact email
Optional: a backlink to ainavhub.com on your site (encouraged but not mandatory)
Optional: 'Buy Me A Coffee' donation for the 'quick submission' tier (24h review, homepage + featured ad placement for 14 days, dofollow)
workflow: Fill Website Name, Website URL, Email and hit Submit
For the paid quick route: donate via buymeacoffee.com/ainavhub, then email lyqtzs@gmail.com with your site details - handled within 24 hours
watchFor: The 'quick submission' path is informal: pay via Buy Me A Coffee, then EMAIL the details - there is no integrated checkout
Paid perks are time-boxed (14 days homepage + featured styles); the permanent listing is the base result
FAQ says the backlink is 'encouraged' - the free form may still rank/delay listings without one (unspecified)
Site lists some NSFW-adjacent tools; check brand-safety fit of the neighborhood
countsAsLive: The tool appears on ainavhub.com under /ai/<slug> and shows in its category listing (and homepage for paid quick submissions).
unknowns: Free-tier review turnaround (only the paid 24h SLA is stated)
Whether free links are dofollow (paid copy says all backlinks are dofollow, ambiguous for free)
